__comment: Universal Transfer Plan (M2) stage 선언 config. 모든 전사 단계는 (stage, 타깃 맵 페인팅, assignments) 프리미티브의 인스턴스 — 신규 단계는 여기 선언만으로 추가된다. 모든 stage는 자기 `source` 블록에 역할을 인라인 선언한다 — 위임(`source_config_ref`)은 2026-08-14에 은퇴했다(server/M1_SOURCE_CONFIG_REF.RETIRED.md). fail_sources.frame='origin'은 출신(core) 프레임 fail을 origin_log 조인으로 타깃(tape) 좌표에 투영한다.

dt.description: DT(Die Transfer): 코어 웨이퍼의 칩을 테이프에 전사하는 단계. 소스 가용 = 코어 웨이퍼 맵의 칩 − 이미 전사된 칩(dt_log).
dt.__source_comment: [2026-08-14] This stage used to delegate its source roles to M1 `bonding_plan_config.json` via `"source_config_ref": "bonding_plan"`. All five delegated roles read `missing` on the live server, for TWO different causes, both measured: (a) `core_defect_map` / `eds_fail_map` / `wafer_process` are not declared in `table_config.json`, so no dynamic model exists (their auto-update generators are in `auto_update_control.disabled` and they left `table_config` between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-04 — retired fixture tables that still hold rows); (b) `used_chips` pointed at `bonding_log.core_lot/core_slot/cx/cy`, columns that exist PHYSICALLY but are absent from that table's `table_config` declaration, and are NULL on all 357,796 rows anyway. The roles below are bound to the tables the live model actually uses. `process_history` and `fail_sources` are DELIBERATELY not declared — there is no registered per-wafer process table, and no declared fail-value vocabulary for `core_wafer_map.c_bn`; the response names both absences in `inactive_subtractions` rather than pretending the subtraction happened.

total_chips.__comment: The core wafer's own chip map. 🔴 x/y ARE DECLARED HERE ON PURPOSE, and this is NOT the same case as `bonding.bin_map` below. Derivation (`bonding_plan.resolve_effective_columns`) only fills roles that the CALLING site marks `required`, and every site that resolves `total_chips` asks for `("lot", "slot")` only (`transfer_plan._summarize_inline`, and the `total_pts` fetch that region/BIN totals depend on). So x/y are never derived for this role: omit them and `total_pts` stays None and every region/BIN total reads null — measured 2026-08-14 on the bonding stage, which had them deleted. `bin_map`'s x/y are a different case: BIN_AXIS_ROLES marks them required, so there deletion really does hand the job to the map binding.

transfer_log.__comment: Core chips already transferred off this wafer. 🔴 x/y are the CORE-frame pair (`core_x`/`core_y`), which is a genuine departure from this table's map binding (`map_overlay_config.table_bindings.dt_log` -> `dt_x`/`dt_y`, the TAPE frame). `DERIVED_ROLE_OF`'s own comment names this case: a second coordinate pair on one table cannot be chosen by the map binding, so it must be declared. Deleting these two lines does not fall back to derivation — for an OPTIONAL role nothing is ever filled — it silently drops the set subtraction to `connected(count_only)`.

bonding.description: Bonding: 테이프 위의 칩을 base에 본딩하는 단계. 테이프에는 여러 코어 칩이 혼재하고 불량도 섞여 있다 — 코어 fail은 dt_log 조인으로 테이프 좌표에 투영된다.
bonding.__bin_map_comment: x/y are ABSENT ON PURPOSE — they are inherited from the map binding for this table (map_overlay_config.table_bindings.dt_map -> dt_x/dt_y, itself derivable from table_config). Do not re-add them: a declared role out-ranks the derivation, so a wrong spelling here cannot be fixed by editing it, only by deleting it. That is the 2026-08-04 incident (`"x": "x"` on a table whose coordinates are dt_x/dt_y), and it sat in this file until 2026-08-11. 🔴 This holds because BIN_AXIS_ROLES marks x/y REQUIRED — see `source.total_chips` below for the optional-role case, where deletion switches the capability off instead. | lot/slot/bin ARE declared because they are genuine departures: key roles are never derived (bonding_plan.DERIVED_ROLE_OF), and `bin` would derive `dt_index` (this table's map VALUE column), which is not the bin. Ask `GET /admin/config/resolve?domain=binding` what actually won.

identity.__comment: 🔴 ROLE keys, not column names. `map_overlay.compose_map_id` looks each entry up in a `{"lot": ..., "slot": ...}` value dict, so a column-name spelling finds nothing. Measured 2026-08-14: `["dt_lot", "dt_slot"]` (which stood here) composes the map id `"_"`; `["lot", "slot"]` composes `"CL-2601-001_03"`. Inert today — the only reader is the origin-frame fail projection and this stage declares no `fail_sources` — so it was a latent wrong answer, not a live one. This equals the default, so deleting the whole block is also correct.

total_chips.__comment: 2026-08-14, TWO repairs on the same four lines — read both before editing. (1) `"x": "x", "y": "y"` was wrong: `dt_map`'s coordinates are `dt_x`/`dt_y`. (2) DELETING them did not fix it, and that is the correction to the first repair's reasoning. Measured on the live server after the deletion: `GET /api/transfer-plan/source-summary?stage=bonding&lot=DT_LOT&slot=1&bins=` still answered `"total": null` with `"총칩 좌표를 알 수 없어 BIN별 총계를 계산할 수 없습니다"` — the owner's original symptom — while the role status went from `connected(column_unresolved:x,y)` to a clean `connected`. The deletion removed the only visible sign and left the capability off. 🔴 THE RULE, precisely: `bonding_plan.resolve_effective_columns` fills a role only if the CALLER marked it `required`. `bin_map` (above) resolves against BIN_AXIS_ROLES = (lot, slot, x, y, bin), so x/y ARE required there and deletion genuinely hands them to the map binding — that is the 2026-08-04 case and it stands. `total_chips` is resolved with `("lot", "slot")` at every site (`transfer_plan._summarize_inline`, and the `total_pts` fetch behind region/BIN totals), so its x/y are OPTIONAL, never derived, and must be spelled here. "Delete, do not respell" is a rule about REQUIRED roles only. Ask `GET /admin/transfer-plan/dry-run` which spelling won.

__plan_store_comment: 계획 모델 v2 — 계획 정체성은 (ref_table, map_key), 즉 '지금 열어 편집 중인 그 맵'이다. 계획 헤더(transfer_plan)와 계획 맵 사본(transfer_plan_map) 역할은 폐기됐다: 페인팅 결과가 곧 대상 맵 자신의 셀이므로 사본이 존재할 이유가 없고, stage는 stages.*.target_map.table 역인덱스로 유도된다. [M2.6] doe·doe_source 역할도 폐기됐다 — legend 행 하나가 곧 DOE 조건 하나다. [ZONE 2026-07-28] 층 구조는 그 행의 zone 컬럼 넷(stack·mat_1h·mat_mid·mat_top)이다: STACK = 총 층수, 1H = 1층, TOP = STACK층, MID = 그 사이 전부. 세 구역이 1..STACK을 구성적으로 덮으므로 겹침·구멍 검사는 사라진 것이 아니라 말할 수 없는 상태가 됐다. 필수 역할키: registry=(ref_table, map_key, value, stack, mat_1h, mat_mid, mat_top) — 하나라도 빠지면 validate가 404다(조용히 '구조 없음'으로 통과시키지 않는다). bands는 필수에서 빠졌다: 폐기됐고 writer가 없으므로 필수일 수 없다. 다만 실계획이 아직 그 컬럼에 있으므로 선언돼 있으면 계속 읽어 zone으로 옮기며(bands_to_zones), 세 구역으로 표현할 수 없는 배치는 접지 않고 거부한다. material_identity는 이제 게이트로만 쓴다 — 토큰 문법 lot[_slot][:BIN]은 contracts/doe_band_rules의 공유 계약이고 parse_material_token이 유일한 구현이다(클라는 config를 읽지 못하므로 파싱 규칙이 config에 살면 양쪽이 갈린다). 미선언이면 모든 자재가 source_unresolved가 되고 계획은 unverified로 남는다.
